name: Title 1
text: Wi-Fi vs BLE: Design Rationale

name: Footer Placeholder 3
text: Dept. of Electronics and Communication Engineering, NMIT, Bengaluru

name: BLE fits the phone gateway design. Phone prox
text: BLE fits the phone gateway design. Phone proximity remains a requirement.

preview: Criterion | Earlier Wi-Fi approach | Selected BLE approach

text:
Design rationale, not measured Wi-Fi versus BLE test results. The earlier project README describes direct ESP32 Wi-Fi MQTT/TLS upload. The current architecture moves internet upload, GPS and planned buffering to the phone, while BLE carries nearby vital observations. Wi-Fi also supports local communication without internet, and a phone hotspot can provide a Wi-Fi uplink. The selected design removes Wi-Fi credentials and cloud connection handling from the ESP32 local link; it does not establish better latency, reliability, range or measured power consumption. BLE is designed for low-power point-to-point data exchange, including health monitoring. A fair empirical comparison would use the same board, workload, distance and observation duration, recording current draw, delivery ratio, update interval and recovery time. Sources: https://www.bluetooth.com/learn-about-bluetooth/topology-options/ ; https://www.bluetooth.com/bluetooth-le-primer/ ; https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/latest/esp32/api-reference/bluetooth/bt_le.html ; earlier project README at D:/Academ/Projects/Major Project 2026-27/Coding Part/Smart Ambulance/README.md.
